title: Master equations with an individual noise on finite state graphs
summary: We develop a classical well-posedness and regularity theory on a finite connected weighted graph for an extended mean field game system, its associated master equation, and a Hamilton-Jacobi- Bellman equation on the probability simplex, all in the presence of an individual noise operator.
